name: Archery
description:
When you attack with a ranged weapon, upgrade the weapon's damage dice by one type (d6 becomes d8, etc.).

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Accurate
improvements.description: When you attack with a ranged weapon, the attack roll is favored.

improvements.name: Deadly
improvements.description: When you attack and hit with a ranged weapon, if you roll max damage on at least one damage die, the target rolls Injury.

improvements.name: Quick Shot
improvements.description: Whenever you spend an action to make an attack with a ranged weapon, you may instead make two ranged attacks with that weapon.
